blocks.tamil_translation: O You who do not fear the calamities of time! O You who know the weights of the mountains, the measures of the seas, the number of the raindrops, the number of the leaves of the trees! And O You who know the number of all that is hidden in the darkness of the night and all that shines in the light of the day! No heaven can conceal another heaven from Him, no earth can conceal another earth from Him, no sea can conceal from Him what is in its depths, no mountain can conceal from Him what is within its firm rock. Make the last part of my life the very best! Make my last deed the very best deed! Make the day I meet You (the day of my death) an excellent day!" — he was making this du'a. The Prophet ﷺ appointed a man to bring him to him when he finished praying. Accordingly, after he prayed, he came to the gathering of Rasulullah ﷺ. Some gold from a gold mine had come to the Prophet ﷺ as a gift, and he gave it to him as a gift. He asked him, "Which tribe do you belong to?" He said, "O Rasulullah! I belong to the tribe of 'Banu Amir'"'. When Rasulullah ﷺ asked, "Do you know why I gave you the gold as a present?" he said, "O Rasulullah! You gave it as a present because of the ties of kinship between you and us." The Prophet ﷺ explained, "Kinship does have its due; however, I gave you the gold only because you praised Allah in a most beautiful way!"

blocks.text: Explanation:- In Nafl Salah, du'as such as this may be recited in every position.
